agrosphere-orchestrator.overview: PROPOSED CHANGE, not approved. Current 1B historical checkpoint conflict remains blocked. Separate historical evidence disposition from acceptance and execution.
agrosphere-orchestrator.business: Permit a narrowly authenticated evidence relationship decision after reviewed provenance; preserve all historic assertions and reject unknown/current contradictions.
agrosphere-orchestrator.architecture: Extend existing authenticated governance and append-only audit with an evidence-bound subject and classifier consumer; no parallel approval service, schema migration or approval bypass.
agrosphere-orchestrator.service: Bind original and supporting evidence digests, application manifest, target milestone and disposition. Recheck subject/authority/expiry/revocation during decision and discovery. Preserve current run and prior snapshots.

diagrams.rationale: Proposed integration reuses authenticated authority and keeps acceptance separate.
Every unknown or invalid authority state fails closed; no accepted/completed transition.
